label: GO after a reward, choosing a2, late in the episode (trials ~55-90)
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), and only when the agent is choosing a2 (model_act==2; 99.9% of activations on a2 choices, mass concentrated at choice logit < -8.9). Never fires at D1/D2, after unrewarded trials, or on a1 choices. It is also strongly gated by episode time: essentially silent before trial ~40, peaks at trials 60-89, and drops out at 90-99. Without the episode-time condition (GO & prev_reward==1 & a2) recall is 1.0 but precision 0.27; adding ep_trial 55-89 gives dev F1 0.74 / mass recall 0.92. All variables are observed or the agent own choice (ep_trial is not an input but is not future). Magnitude: largest on the first rewarded trial after an unrewarded one (prev-prev reward == 0 covers 68% of the top quartile vs 7% of the bottom quartile), decaying across consecutive rewarded a2 trials (e.g. 0.94, 0.41, 0.20, 0.14); top examples often follow rare transitions. Remaining false positives are mostly long runs of rewarded a2 trials where the feature has decayed to zero.
